svg.title: Micro Color Panel — editable control map
svg.desc: Flat vector illustration traced from the supplied front-view photograph. Twelve encoders, forty buttons, three independent outer rings, and three trackballs. Each control is a named, keyboard-focusable SVG group. All artwork is vector; no raster images or external assets. Control IDs are UI identifiers, not hardware protocol codes.
